title: Reality Fracture | Episode 6: The Man Who Kills His Own Ambition

entities.name: Tam
entities.description: An artificial gorgon who, after talking to the Theorist, resolves to stop him and finds she can counter his commands.

entities.name: The Theorist
entities.description: The clinical remnant of Jace who commands the Echoverse, defeats Tam's friends and sheds another aberration.

entities.name: The Nihilist
entities.description: A half-compleated aberration of Jace with cables for limbs, who holds that his own death will mean nothing and says the one lesson they never learned was to ask for help.

entities.name: The Detective
entities.description: A shackled aberration of Jace in a brown trench coat, the part that sees how it all fits together, who asks Vraska to let him die to stall the Theorist.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon planeswalker captured by a statue of the Theorist who ends up speaking with the Detective and kissing him.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer planeswalker who declares Jace her friend and fights her cryomancer double.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A leonin planeswalker who still speaks no English and follows the others into the memory well.

entities.name: Garruk Wildspeaker
entities.description: A planeswalker druid weakened by the Theorist who finds his double has embraced the Chain Veil.

entities.name: Echoverse Chandra
entities.description: A blue-streaked cryomancer version of Chandra in which her father did not die, who attacks the allies.

entities.name: Echoverse Vraska
entities.description: A taller gorgon double of Vraska who cannot petrify and is the Theorist's architect.

entities.name: Echoverse Ajani
entities.description: A hulking merciless leonin double wielding two axe heads on a chain.

entities.name: Echoverse Garruk
entities.description: A double of Garruk with an ogre skull pauldron who embraced the Chain Veil.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: The world-ender Tam met on Innistrad, who once played chess with Jace.

entities.name: Jadzi
entities.description: The oracle whom the Theorist has imprisoned.

entities.name: Loot
entities.description: A creature in the Theorist's and Vraska's family.

entities.name: Pewter
entities.description: Jace's childhood horse whose horseshoe is in his bedroom.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: The original mind-mage whose fragments are the Theorist and aberrations.

entities.name: The Soldier
entities.description: Another aberration of Jace whom the Detective says they need to find.

entities.name: The Chain Veil
entities.description: An artifact whose violet glow marks Garruk's double.

entities.name: Mage Hunters
entities.description: Predators that prowl the Eradia.

entities.name: Hexhaven Academy
entities.description: The tower of Jace's memories with a sanctum at the top.

entities.name: The Sanctum
entities.description: The Theorist's sanctum ringed with mage-rings.

entities.name: The Echoverse
entities.description: The Theorist's replacement Multiverse, which is fraying.

entities.name: The Eradia
entities.description: The wasteland around the tower.

entities.name: Memory Traps
entities.description: Rooms of Jace's memories, including a marble plain with a well, a general's tent, a childhood bedroom and a lecture hall.

entities.name: Professor Opal
entities.description: The Echoverse's healer version of Liliana who left after healing the allies.

events.summary: Tam goes to the Theorist and asks where the Echoverse versions of her friends are; he says they were skipped or removed.
events.quote: "They're not here. The process of creation is autonomous. Some things are likely to be skipped. Or removed. It's bound to happen."

events.summary: The Theorist reads Tam's mind, learns she met Emrakul, and says Emrakul will be eliminated by the overwrite; Tam pushes back angrily.
events.quote: But he saw enough. "You spoke to Emrakul."

events.summary: The Theorist commands Tam to stop, but she counters his command and says she will no longer help.
events.quote: "This experiment has gone too far," she announces. "I won't help you anymore!"

events.summary: The Theorist releases another aberration, the Nihilist, who tells Tam she cannot win.
events.quote: A thud. Lungs drawing air. A second man lies on the floor.

events.summary: The Nihilist says the experiment is tearing the original Multiverse and that their death will mean nothing; he tells Tam to ask for help, and the Theorist kicks him through a portal.
events.quote: "Aberration!" snarls the Theorist, and a half-second later he flashes a portal into existence and kicks the Nihilist through it.

events.summary: Tam resolves to help stop her maker.
events.quote: Her mentor must be stopped, and she must aid in his downfall.

events.summary: Chandra tells Vraska she wants her friend Jace back so she can kick his ass, and breaks into tears.
events.quote: I want my friend back so I can kick his ass!

events.summary: Chandra's cryomancer double appears and attacks the group with ice, and the allies jump out the window into the courtyard.
Doubles of Ajani, Garruk and Vraska arrive, and Vraska guides Chandra in a blind fight.
events.quote: "It's my double! It takes a few seconds for petrification to charge.

events.summary: Echoverse Vraska animates a statue of the Theorist that crushes Vraska and Chandra.
events.quote: It is Jace as the Theorist, twice as tall as the real one

events.summary: The Theorist asks Vraska to give up, but she spits in his face and demands Beleren back, and he throws them into a portal.
events.quote: Vraska feels herself being hoisted up then thrown through the portal into a vast and empty space.

events.summary: In her dormitory, Tam reflects on what she wants and resolves to betray the worst part of her maker in honor of the best parts.
events.quote: I have to betray the worst part of him in honor of the best parts.

events.summary: The allies fall into the tower's memory traps and find a marble plain with a well.
events.quote: It's an infinite plane of marble, endless and bare, with what looks like a well at the center of it.

events.summary: Chandra asks if Jace would have done this had she been nicer, and Vraska tells her she isn't that special.
In a lecture hall they find the number of beings in the Multiverse on a chalkboard and meet the Detective, an aberration of Jace.
events.quote: Jace steps through, but not the one from upstairs.

events.summary: The Detective explains that the body is connected to the illusion and proposes that killing the body will stall the overlay, and that they need the Soldier.
events.quote: We'll need to find him. Then we'll have a chance to finish the task and eliminate the body.

events.summary: The Detective apologizes to Vraska, saying he loved all of them, and Vraska embraces him, saying we are who we choose to be.
events.quote: "You are no monster," she says with gritted teeth. "We are who we choose to be."

events.summary: The Detective says he chooses to be the man who kills his own ambition, and Vraska kisses him.
events.quote: "I choose to be the man who kills his own ambition."

events.summary: Vraska realizes that for the spell to slow, Jace's body must die.
events.quote: Vraska, lip trembling, finishes her conclusion. "You need to die."

relations.note: Her cryomancer double attacks her, representing a Chandra whose father did not die.
relations.quote: "It's me if Dad didn't die," she groans.

relations.note: She calls herself the Theorist's architect and rides his statue.
relations.quote: I'm not his lover, I'm his architect.

relations.note: The double fights Vraska and mocks her.
relations.quote: "You got shut in too many cages, girl,"

relations.note: Vraska kisses the Detective, the part of Jace she trusts most.
relations.quote: Without hesitation, she leans forward and kisses him.

relations.note: Tam resolves to stop and betray the worst part of her maker.
The Detective is an aberration, a part of Jace, who solved the mystery of Innistrad.
relations.quote: "He's the Detective. He solved the mystery of what was happening to Innistrad."
